Use @Image1 as the starting frame.
Steady handheld drift left, gently tracking @Image2 as she pads barefoot across the pale wooden floor toward the sunlit vanity. She walks with relaxed natural gait, loose linen shirt shifting, arms swinging lightly, gaze soft toward the open glass doors then the vanity, soft smile holding. Ocean breeze lifts white curtain panels and trails of her hair; bright morning sun throws shifting light patterns across the floor as she nears the chair and vanity surface, ready to arrive for the next beat.

soft ocean waves and distant surf through open doors, gentle coastal morning breeze. soft barefoot steps on wood floor, light flutter of curtains in breeze, faint fabric rustle of linen shirt.

Single continuous shot, no cuts. Avoid jitter and bent limbs.
